t: DEWALT TSTAK site radio provides robust audio for busy construction sites and demanding workshops. The durable jobsite radio offers DAB, FM, and AM reception, ensuring access to a wide range of stations. Can be controlled remotely via mobile app. Featuring a powerful 4 x tweeters and 2 x subwoofer speakers with 100dB volume, it delivers high-quality sound across the workspace. Connectivity includes Bluetooth for streaming music from mobile devices, alongside USB and Aux inputs. Designed for challenging environments, the radio is both impact and water-resistant, making it a reliable choice for builders and electricians. Mains or battery-powered (batteries sold separately), it integrates seamlessly with any TSTAK module for easy transport and storage.
b: Mains or Battery-Powered (Includes Plug but No Battery)
Playback via Bluetooth / USB / Aux Input
4 x Tweeters & 2 Subwoofers Speakers on Board
LED Display for Power, Duration & Clock
